SYMPTOM: Space bar in letter layout did not insert space when tapped.
CAUSE: Letter layout used `makeLetterKey(title: "")` (empty string). The alt/symbols layout used `makeLetterKey(title: "space")`. The empty title caused the button wiring to fail silently.
FIX: Changed letter layout space key to `makeLetterKey(title: "space")` to match the working alt layout pattern. The visible 'space' label also confirms the button is correctly placed.
PREVENT: Always use a non-empty title for special keys (space, delete, return) to ensure button actions wire correctly.
